explain_yue: 學校係你朝早返去上課、見同學嘅地方。
example_en: I go to school by bus.
example_zh: 我搭巴士返學。
tip: 返學就係 go to school；放學可以講 after school。
icon_idea: a sleepy kitten walking into school with a tiny satchel

explain_yue: 課室係你坐低聽書、做工作紙嘅房間。
example_en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
example_zh: 我哋課室喺二樓。
tip: classroom 係課室；class 係一班人，兩個唔好撈亂。
icon_idea: a kitten curled on a classroom chair beside a small desk

explain_yue: 操場係小息跑吓跳吓、上體育堂嘅空地。
example_en: We run in the playground at recess.
example_zh: 小息我哋喺操場跑。
tip: 香港學校嘅操場成日就叫 playground，小息可以出嚟行吓。
icon_idea: a kitten stretched out on a sunny playground slide

explain_yue: 飯堂係學校入面買嘢食、食午餐嘅地方。
example_zh: 飯堂有賣魚蛋。
tip: 香港學校飯堂就叫 canteen，買飯可以問 What do you have today?
icon_idea: a kitten at a canteen counter with a fish-ball skewer

explain_yue: 禮堂係開早會、搞活動嘅大房間。
example_en: We have assembly in the hall.
example_zh: 我哋喺禮堂開早會。
tip: school hall 就係禮堂；走廊唔好叫 hall。
icon_idea: a kitten sitting quietly in a big sunny school hall

explain_yue: 走廊係連接課室同廁所嘅通道，行過可以慢慢行。
example_en: The toilet is at the end of the corridor.
example_zh: 廁所喺走廊盡頭。
tip: 問路可以講 at the end of the corridor，即係走廊盡頭。
icon_idea: a kitten peeking down a long quiet school corridor

explain_yue: 校門係出入學校嘅門口，家長通常喺度接你。
example_en: Wait for me at the gate.
example_zh: 喺校門等我。
tip: school gate 就係校門；約人可以講 at the gate。
icon_idea: a kitten waiting at a school gate with one paw raised

explain_yue: 教員室係老師休息、改簿嘅房間，入去之前先敲門就得。
example_zh: 老師喺教員室休息。
tip: staffroom 有時寫成 staff room，都係教員室。
icon_idea: a kitten napping on a staffroom sofa beside a teacup

explain_yue: 實驗室係做科學實驗嘅特別課室，入面有工具同實驗枱。
example_en: Science class meets in the lab.
example_zh: 科學堂喺實驗室上。
tip: lab 係 laboratory 嘅簡稱，科學堂成日喺 lab 上。
icon_idea: a kitten in a tiny lab coat looking at a bubbling beaker

explain_yue: 廁所係去洗手間嘅地方，唔肯定喺邊可以問老師。
example_en: The toilet is next to the stairs.
example_zh: 廁所喺樓梯隔離。
tip: 英式同香港成日講 toilet；美式成日講 restroom。
icon_idea: a kitten pointing a paw toward a toilet door sign

explain_yue: 通告係貼出嚟俾全校睇嘅消息，例如假期同比賽。
example_en: There is a notice on the board.
example_zh: 壁報板有張通告。
tip: notice board 就係壁報板；notice 做動詞係留意到。
icon_idea: a kitten reading a notice pinned on a board

explain_yue: 儲物櫃係你放書包同書嘅小櫃，記得自己把鎖就得。
example_en: My locker is beside the door.
example_zh: 我個儲物櫃喺門邊。
tip: 鎖要鎖好可以講 lock your locker。
icon_idea: a kitten opening a small locker with one paw

explain_yue: 時間表話你知每一日上咩堂、幾點小息。
example_zh: 上堂之前睇吓時間表。
tip: 英式叫 timetable；美式成日叫 schedule。
icon_idea: a kitten studying a colourful school timetable

explain_yue: 上課鐘一響，就知道要返課室或者可以去小息。
example_zh: 八點打鐘。
tip: 打鐘講 The bell rings.；聽到就可以慢慢行返課室。
icon_idea: a kitten tapping a school bell with one paw

explain_yue: 小息係兩堂中間嘅休息，可以食小食或者行吓。
example_en: We have a break at ten.
example_zh: 十點有小息。
tip: 本季＝小息；另外有「打破」。lunch break 就係午膳時間。
icon_idea: a kitten snoozing at break time with a small snack

explain_yue: recess 都係小息，有啲學校用呢個字代替 break。
example_en: We eat a snack at recess.
example_zh: 小息我哋食小食。
tip: 香港英文成日講 break；recess 一樣係小息，美式學校更常見。
icon_idea: a kitten eating a bun in the sun at recess

explain_yue: 早會係全校或者全級一齊喺禮堂聽校長講嘢。
example_zh: 早會八點十五開始。
tip: morning assembly 就係早會，通常喺 hall 舉行。
icon_idea: a kitten sitting in a calm row at morning assembly

explain_yue: 一班就係同一班房一齊上課嘅同學，例如三甲。
example_zh: 呢班有三十個學生。
tip: 本季＝班；另外有「階級」。課室要講 classroom。
icon_idea: a cluster of kittens sitting together as one class

explain_yue: 年級話你知讀到第幾年，例如 grade two 係二年級。
example_zh: 佢讀二年級。
tip: 本季＝年級；亦可指分數。中學年級香港多用 Form。
icon_idea: a kitten badge showing a small grade number

explain_yue: 喺香港中學，Form 1 就係中一，Form 係年級嘅叫法。
example_zh: 佢讀中一。
tip: 本季＝年級（Form 1）；另外有「表格」。Form 1 即係中一。
icon_idea: a kitten scarf labelled Form 1

explain_yue: 校園係成間學校嘅範圍，包括課室、操場同樹。
example_en: The campus has a big tree.
example_zh: 校園有棵大樹。
tip: on campus 即係喺校園入面；大學都成日用呢個字。
icon_idea: a kitten walking under trees on a quiet campus

explain_yue: 入口係入學校或者入大樓嘅地方，有時同校門係同一個位。
example_zh: 喺入口等我。
tip: 出口係 exit；入口係 entrance。約人可以講 at the entrance。
icon_idea: a kitten standing on a mat at the school entrance

explain_yue: 樓梯係行上落樓嘅級，圖書館如果喺樓上就要行 stairs。
example_en: The library is up the stairs.
example_zh: 圖書館喺樓梯上面。
tip: 多數用複數 stairs；上樓梯講 up the stairs。
icon_idea: a kitten climbing school stairs one step at a time

explain_yue: 黑板係老師用白粉筆寫字嘅深色板，有啲課室仲見得到。
example_en: She writes the date on the blackboard.
example_zh: 佢喺黑板寫日期。
tip: 黑板用粉筆 chalk；白板先用箱頭筆。
icon_idea: a kitten leaving a paw print on a blackboard

explain_yue: 白板係用箱頭筆寫、可以抹走嘅板，好多課室用呢種。
example_en: The homework is on the whiteboard.
example_zh: 功課寫咗喺白板度。
tip: 白板擦叫 board rubber 或者 eraser；寫完可以抹走再寫。
icon_idea: a kitten wiping a whiteboard with a soft cloth

explain_yue: 老師係喺課室教你嘅人，可以叫 Miss 或者 Mr 加姓。
example_zh: 老師同我哋一齊讀。
tip: 女老師常叫 Miss Chan，男老師常叫 Mr Lee，姓放後面。
icon_idea: a kitten with round glasses and a pointer stick

explain_yue: 學生係返學讀書嘅人，中學同大學都成日用 student。
example_en: Every student has a name tag.
example_zh: 每個學生都有名牌。
tip: student 中小學大學都用得；小學有時會改叫 pupil。
icon_idea: a kitten with a name tag and a small school bag

explain_yue: pupil 都係學生，英國同香港小學特別常用呢個字。
example_zh: 嗰個學生靜靜雞排隊。
tip: 小學學生叫 pupil 好自然；中學開始多數叫 student。
icon_idea: a small kitten in a primary-school jumper

explain_yue: 同學係同你一班上課嘅人，可以一齊做練習。
example_zh: 佢係我同學。
tip: 介紹人就講 She is my classmate. 同班先叫 classmate。
icon_idea: two kittens sharing one desk as classmates

explain_yue: 校長係成間學校嘅負責人，早會成日聽到佢把聲。
example_zh: 校長喺早會講話。
tip: 校長男女都叫 principal；principal 做形容詞先係「主要嘅」。
icon_idea: a kitten with a principal badge and a calm smile

explain_yue: headmaster 係男校長，有啲學校仍然用呢個稱呼。
example_zh: 男校長嚟我哋班。
tip: 男校長 headmaster，女校長 headmistress；而家好多學校統一叫 principal。
icon_idea: a kitten in a tidy jacket as the headmaster

explain_yue: 班長係幫老師收功課、傳消息嘅同學。
example_zh: 班長收功課。
tip: 本季 monitor 係班長；電腦螢幕嗰個 monitor 係另一個意思。
icon_idea: a kitten monitor holding a homework tray

explain_yue: 風紀係喺走廊或者校門幫手睇秩序嘅同學。
example_en: A prefect helps at the gate.
example_zh: 風紀喺校門幫手。
tip: 香港學校嘅風紀就係 prefect，通常有臂章。
icon_idea: a kitten prefect with a bright armband

explain_yue: 拍檔係同你一組做練習嘅同學，兩個人一組就係 partner。
example_en: My partner shares a book with me.
example_zh: 我個拍檔同我共用一本書。
tip: 老師話 pair work 就係搵一個 partner 一齊做。
icon_idea: two kittens sharing one book as partners

explain_yue: 小組係幾個人一齊做專題或者討論嘅一組。
example_zh: 我哋組畫地圖。
tip: in a group 即係一組；group work 就係小組活動。
icon_idea: three kittens huddled over one drawing as a group

explain_yue: 訪客係嚟學校睇吓或者講故事嘅客人，唔係日常學生。
example_en: A visitor comes to our class today.
example_zh: 今日有訪客嚟我哋班。
tip: 訪客貼紙成日寫 visitor；動詞係 visit。
icon_idea: a kitten visitor wearing a small guest sticker

explain_yue: 警衛係企喺校門睇住出入嘅人，有時叫保安。
example_zh: 警衛開校門。
tip: 校門嗰位可以叫 the guard；security guard 就係保安。
icon_idea: a kitten guard in a little cap by the school gate

explain_yue: 清潔員係打掃課室同走廊嘅人，香港學校成日叫校工。
example_en: The cleaner keeps the hall tidy.
example_zh: 清潔員保持禮堂乾淨。
tip: 見到校工可以講 Thank you；cleaner 就係做清潔嘅人。
icon_idea: a kitten cleaner with a tiny mop and a happy face

explain_yue: 圖書館管理員係幫你搵書、借書嘅人。
example_en: Ask the librarian for a story book.
example_zh: 同圖書館管理員借故事書。
tip: 借書可以講 Can I borrow this book? 對住 librarian 講就得。
icon_idea: a kitten librarian between tall bookshelves

explain_yue: 導師可以係補習老師，星期六嚟幫你溫書嗰位就係。
example_zh: 我補習老師星期六嚟。
tip: 補習老師叫 tutor；上補習可以講 I have a tutor。
icon_idea: a kitten tutor with a pencil and a gentle smile

explain_yue: headmistress 係女校長，同 headmaster 一樣管成間學校。
example_zh: 女校長歡迎我哋。
tip: 女校長先叫 headmistress；唔肯定性別就用 principal 最穩陣。
icon_idea: a kitten headmistress with a small flower brooch

explain_yue: 助手係幫老師派紙、整理課室嘅人。
example_en: The assistant gives out the paper.
example_zh: 助手派紙。
tip: teaching assistant 就係教學助理，幫老師幫手嘅人。
icon_idea: a kitten assistant carrying a small stack of paper

explain_yue: 同輩係同你差唔多年紀、一齊學嘅人，唔係老師。
example_en: A peer can practise with you.
example_zh: 同輩同學可以同你一齊練。
tip: peer 係同輩；同學之間互相睇作文可以叫 peer reading。
icon_idea: two kittens of the same size studying side by side

explain_yue: 組長係帶住小組開始做嘢嘅同學。
example_en: The leader of our group is kind.
example_zh: 我哋組長人好好。
tip: group leader 就係組長；帶頭做一樣嘢都可以叫 leader。
icon_idea: a kitten leader holding a small flag

explain_yue: 成員係某個學會或者小組入面嘅一份子。
example_en: I am a member of the reading club.
example_zh: 我係閱讀組嘅成員。
tip: 加入學會可以講 I am a member of …
icon_idea: a kitten wearing a club member badge

explain_yue: 義工係自願嚟學校幫手嘅人，例如圖書館義工。
example_en: A volunteer helps in the library.
example_zh: 有義工喺圖書館幫手。
tip: 做義工可以講 I volunteer，呢張卡先當名詞「義工」用。
icon_idea: a kitten volunteer with a soft green scarf

explain_yue: 講者係企出嚟講話或者演講嘅人。
example_en: The speaker tells a cat story.
example_zh: 講者講一個貓故事。
tip: 早會嘉賓可以叫 the speaker；喇叭嗰個 speaker 係另一個意思。
icon_idea: a kitten speaker at a tiny microphone

explain_yue: 聽者係留心聽人講嘢嘅人，跟到就可以點頭。
example_en: A good listener nods and smiles.
example_zh: 一個好嘅聽眾會點頭微笑。
tip: speaker 講，listener 聽；兩個人一組練說話就一講一聽。
icon_idea: a kitten listener with one ear gently tilted

explain_yue: 主持係負責歡迎客人、帶住活動嘅人。
example_zh: 主持歡迎每一位訪客。
tip: 班會或者早會司儀可以叫 the host。
icon_idea: a kitten host offering a welcome card

explain_yue: 副校長係校長嘅副手，校長唔喺度會由佢幫手。
example_zh: 副校長幫校長手。
tip: deputy principal 或者 deputy head 都係副校長。
icon_idea: a kitten deputy with a silver badge beside a bigger chair

explain_yue: 原子筆係用墨水寫字嘅筆，寫完唔使刨。
example_en: I write with a blue pen.
example_zh: 我用藍色原子筆寫。
tip: 借筆可以講 Can I borrow a pen? 用筆寫就 with a pen。
icon_idea: a kitten holding a blue pen

explain_yue: 鉛筆係可以擦走再寫過嘅筆，默書成日用。
example_zh: 可唔可以借支鉛筆？
tip: 鉛筆要刨尖先好寫；顏色筆先叫 colour pencil。
icon_idea: a kitten holding a yellow pencil

explain_yue: eraser 係擦膠嘅美式叫法，用來擦鉛筆痕。
example_en: This eraser is white and soft.
example_zh: 呢塊擦膠白色又軟。
tip: 美式叫 eraser，香港同英國成日叫 rubber，兩樣都係擦膠。
icon_idea: a kitten rubbing a page with a white eraser

explain_yue: rubber 係英國同香港叫擦膠嘅字，同 eraser 一樣用來擦鉛筆。
example_en: I need a rubber for this line.
example_zh: 呢條線我要用擦膠。
tip: 本季 rubber 係擦膠；另外可以指橡膠。借擦膠講 Can I use your rubber?
icon_idea: a kitten holding a small pink rubber

explain_yue: 間尺係畫直線、量長度嘅尺，數學堂成日要攞出嚟。
example_en: Use a ruler to draw the line.
example_zh: 用間尺畫線。
tip: 量長度講 a 15 cm ruler；畫線就 use a ruler。
icon_idea: a kitten drawing a straight line with a ruler

explain_yue: 較剪係剪紙嘅工具，講英文嘅時候當複數用。
example_zh: 呢把較剪用來剪紙。
tip: 永遠講 these scissors are，唔好講 a scissors。一把可以講 a pair of scissors。
icon_idea: a kitten cutting paper with round-tip scissors

explain_yue: 膠水係將紙黏住嘅嘢，美勞堂成日用膠水棒。
example_en: The glue is in my pencil case.
example_zh: 膠水喺我筆盒度。
tip: 膠水棒叫 a glue stick；液體膠水叫 glue。
icon_idea: a kitten squeezing a glue stick

explain_yue: 膠紙係用來貼紙或者貼好撕爛位嘅膠帶。
example_en: I stick the corner with tape.
example_zh: 我用膠紙貼個角。
tip: 透明膠紙叫 sticky tape 或者 Sellotape；紙膠可以講 masking tape。
icon_idea: a kitten sticking tape on a paper corner

explain_yue: 蠟筆係顏色厚、用來填色嘅筆，低年級美勞常用。
example_en: A red crayon is good for the sun.
example_zh: 紅色蠟筆適合畫太陽。
tip: 一盒蠟筆叫 a box of crayons；一支就 a crayon。
icon_idea: a kitten colouring a sun with a red crayon

explain_yue: 箱頭筆係寫白板嘅粗筆，寫完可以用板擦抹走。
example_en: The marker is on the whiteboard.
example_zh: 箱頭筆喺白板上面。
tip: 白板筆叫 whiteboard marker；寫海報可以用 marker。
icon_idea: a kitten drawing with a thick marker

explain_yue: 螢光筆係將重點劃成黃色或者粉色，方便之後溫。
example_en: I use a highlighter for new words.
example_zh: 我用螢光筆劃生字。
tip: 劃重點講 highlight the word；支筆本身叫 a highlighter。
icon_idea: a kitten highlighting a word in yellow

explain_yue: 筆記簿係你抄筆記同生字嘅簿，唔係學校派嘅課本。
example_en: I write the date in my notebook.
example_zh: 我喺筆記簿寫日期。
tip: notebook 係筆記簿；laptop 先係手提電腦，唔好撈亂。
icon_idea: a kitten writing the date in a small notebook

explain_yue: 課本係學校指定嘅書，每一科通常有自己一本。
example_en: Open your textbook to chapter two.
example_zh: 打開課本第二章。
tip: 揭去某一頁可以講 Open your textbook to page 12.
icon_idea: a kitten opening a fat textbook

explain_yue: 文件夾係放入工作紙、唔使打孔嘅夾。
example_en: Put the worksheet in this folder.
example_zh: 將工作紙放入呢個文件夾。
tip: 塑膠文件夾成日叫 folder；電腦入面嘅資料夾都叫 folder。
icon_idea: a kitten sliding paper into a folder

explain_yue: 喺學校，file 多數係放工作紙嘅文件夾，帶返屋企都方便。
example_en: My file holds all the worksheets.
example_zh: 我個文件夾放晒工作紙。
tip: 學校講嘅 file 多數係文件夾；電腦檔案都叫 file，要睇上文。
icon_idea: a kitten hugging a school file

explain_yue: 背包係背住返學嘅袋，兩邊有帶，可以放手。
example_en: My backpack is by the door.
example_zh: 我個背包喺門邊。
tip: 英式亦叫 rucksack；香港學生背包成日講 backpack 或者 school bag。
icon_idea: a yawning kitten wearing a backpack

explain_yue: 筆盒係放筆、間尺同擦膠嘅盒，平時英文多數寫成 pencil case 兩個字。
example_en: My pencilcase is full of pens.
example_zh: 我個筆盒裝滿筆。
tip: 呢張卡字面寫 pencilcase；出街寫信可以寫 pencil case，意思一樣。
icon_idea: a kitten unzipping a full pencil case

explain_yue: 釘書機係將幾張紙釘埋一齊嘅工具。
example_en: The stapler is on the teacher's desk.
example_zh: 釘書機喺老師枱上面。
tip: 釘書釘叫 staples；部機叫 stapler。釘一釘可以講 staple the pages。
icon_idea: a kitten pressing a small stapler

explain_yue: 夾子係夾住幾頁紙嘅小鐵夾，唔使釘穿張紙。
example_zh: 呢個夾夾住啲頁。
tip: 萬字夾叫 a paper clip；大夾可以叫 a bulldog clip。
icon_idea: a kitten clipping pages with a silver clip

explain_yue: 紙係你寫字、畫圖用嘅張紙，數一張要加 a piece of。
example_en: I need a piece of paper.
example_zh: 我需要一張紙。
tip: 一張紙講 a piece of paper 或者 a sheet of paper，唔好講 a paper 當一張紙。
icon_idea: a kitten holding a blank sheet of paper

explain_yue: 頁係書或者簿入面嘅一版，老師會叫你揭去某一頁。
example_zh: 揭到第十頁。
tip: 揭頁講 turn to page 10；page 後面嘅數字通常唔加 the。
icon_idea: a kitten turning a book page with a paw

explain_yue: 封面係書最外面嗰頁，保護入面嘅紙。
example_en: The cover of my book is blue.
example_zh: 我本書封面係藍色。
tip: 書套叫 a book cover；cover 做動詞先係「蓋住」。
icon_idea: a kitten admiring a blue book cover

explain_yue: 筆刨係將鉛筆刨尖嘅小工具。
example_en: The sharpener is in my pencilcase.
example_zh: 筆刨喺筆盒入面。
tip: 全名係 pencil sharpener；刨鉛筆可以講 sharpen a pencil。
icon_idea: a kitten sharpening a pencil

explain_yue: 計算機係幫你計數嘅機，數學堂老師話得先用。
example_en: I use a calculator in maths.
example_zh: 上數學我用計算機。
tip: 計數機叫 calculator；電腦先叫 computer。
icon_idea: a kitten tapping a calculator

explain_yue: 墨水係筆入面寫出字嘅液體，原子筆同鋼筆都有。
example_en: The ink in this pen is black.
example_zh: 呢支筆嘅墨水係黑色。
tip: ink 多數當不可數；黑色墨水就 black ink。
icon_idea: a kitten looking at a drop of black ink

explain_yue: 科目係你返學讀嘅一科，例如英文、數學、科學。
example_zh: 我最鍾意嘅科目係美術。
tip: 問人鍾意咩科可以講 What is your favourite subject? 本季 subject 係科目。
icon_idea: a kitten pointing at a list of school subjects

explain_yue: 英文科係學英語嘅堂，香港幾乎日日都有。
example_zh: 英文九點開始。
tip: 科目名 English 要大寫；我讀英文可以講 I study English。
icon_idea: a kitten with an English book and a teacup

explain_yue: 中文科係學中文閱讀同寫作嘅堂。
example_zh: 中文喺午餐之前。
tip: 科目名 Chinese 要大寫；普通話科係 Putonghua，唔好撈亂。
icon_idea: a kitten reading a Chinese storybook

explain_yue: maths 係數學嘅英式簡稱，香港學校成日咁寫。
example_en: Maths is fun with a snack.
example_zh: 食住小食上數學都幾好玩。
tip: 英式同香港寫 maths；美式寫 math。後面動詞用單數，Maths is …
icon_idea: a kitten with numbers and a fish snack

explain_yue: mathematics 係數學嘅全名，平時講開可以講 maths。
example_en: Mathematics is the full name of maths.
example_zh: Mathematics 係 maths 嘅全名。
tip: 全名 mathematics 尾唔使加 s 變複數；口語用 maths 就夠。
icon_idea: a kitten beside a big mathematics book

explain_yue: 科學係做實驗、認識自然嘅科目，中學先再細分。
example_en: We have science in the lab.
example_zh: 我哋喺實驗室上科學。
tip: 科學堂成日喺 lab；小學常識唔等於 science。
icon_idea: a kitten in a lab with a tiny telescope

explain_yue: 歷史係講以前發生過咩事嘅科目。
example_zh: 歷史講舊時嘅故事。
tip: 讀歷史可以講 I study history；故事本身唔等於歷史科。
icon_idea: a kitten unrolling an old history scroll

explain_yue: 地理係講地圖、天氣同地方嘅科目。
example_zh: 地理教我哋睇地圖。
tip: 簡稱有時寫 Geog；地圖係 map，科目先係 geography。
icon_idea: a kitten looking at a geography map

explain_yue: 美術係畫畫同做手工嘅科目。
example_zh: 星期五有美術。
tip: 上美術堂講 have art；美勞室可以叫 the art room。
icon_idea: a kitten painting with a colourful paw print

explain_yue: PE 係體育課，通常喺操場或者禮堂上。
example_zh: 今日有體育堂。
tip: PE 係 Physical Education 嘅簡稱，時間表上成日就寫 PE。
icon_idea: a kitten in sports kit stretching lazily

explain_yue: 呢度 computer 係電腦科，即係學用電腦嘅堂，唔係淨係指部機。
example_zh: 午餐之後有電腦科。
tip: 時間表上嘅 computer 係電腦科；部電腦本身都叫 a computer。
icon_idea: a kitten at a school computer with a small timetable

explain_yue: 普通話科係練聽同講普通話嘅堂，香港小學多數有。
example_zh: 星期二朝早有普通話。
tip: Putonghua 要大寫；中文科係 Chinese，普通話科先係 Putonghua。
icon_idea: a kitten with a speech bubble of Putonghua tones

explain_yue: 一堂就係一段上課時間，例如下一堂係科學。
example_zh: 下一堂係科學。
tip: 下一堂講 the next lesson；上堂可以講 have a lesson。
icon_idea: a kitten sitting through a cosy lesson

explain_yue: 一節係時間表上面嘅一格課，first period 即係第一節。
example_zh: 第一節係英文。
tip: 本季 period 係一節課；句號都叫 full stop，美式先成日叫 period。
icon_idea: a kitten clock showing the first period

explain_yue: 章係書入面嘅一大段，課本會寫 chapter 3。
example_zh: 今日我哋讀第三章。
tip: 第三章講 chapter three 或者 chapter 3，數字前通常冇 the。
icon_idea: a kitten opening chapter three of a book

explain_yue: 課題係今日堂上要學嘅主題，例如動物。
example_zh: 今日課題係動物。
tip: 今日課題可以講 Today's topic is … 作文題目有時都叫 topic。
icon_idea: a kitten card labelled with today's topic

explain_yue: 專題研習係用幾日或者幾星期做完嘅功課，通常要一組人。
example_en: Our project is about the school.
example_zh: 我哋專題係關於學校。
tip: 做專題講 do a project；名詞讀 /ˈprɒdʒekt/。
icon_idea: a kitten with a project poster of the school

explain_yue: 實驗係科學堂動手試吓、睇結果嘅活動。
example_en: The experiment needs water and a cup.
example_zh: 呢個實驗要水同一隻杯。
tip: 做實驗講 do an experiment；通常喺 lab 做。
icon_idea: a kitten watching a gentle experiment in a cup

explain_yue: 工作紙係老師派嘅一張練習紙，做完可以交。
example_zh: 喺課堂做完張工作紙。
tip: 一張叫 a worksheet；做完講 finish the worksheet。
icon_idea: a kitten filling a worksheet with paw ticks

explain_yue: 默書係老師讀、你寫出嚟嘅小測，香港小學好常見。
example_zh: 星期四朝早有默書。
tip: 香港學校默書就叫 dictation；有時簡稱 dic。
icon_idea: a kitten writing dictation in a quiet pose

explain_yue: 作文係用自己嘅句子寫一篇文章，中英文堂都有。
example_en: The composition is about my pet.
example_zh: 作文題目係我隻寵物。
tip: 作文可以叫 composition 或者 essay；香港小學成日講 composition。
icon_idea: a kitten writing a composition about a pet

explain_yue: 閱讀係睇書或者睇文章嘅練習，可以喺堂上靜靜做。
example_zh: 午餐之後係閱讀時間。
tip: 閱讀時段叫 reading time；動詞先係 read。
icon_idea: a kitten reading under a sunny window

explain_yue: 寫作係用文字寫出句子同文章嘅練習。
example_en: Writing is quiet time in class.
example_zh: 寫作係堂上安靜嘅時間。
tip: 英文卷嘅 writing 係寫作部分；動詞係 write。
icon_idea: a kitten writing slowly with a cup of tea nearby

explain_yue: 說話係開口講英文嘅練習，通常兩個人一組。
example_zh: 說話練習兩個人一組。
tip: 口試入面嘅 speaking 就係說話部分；動詞係 speak。
icon_idea: two kittens speaking together in a pair

explain_yue: 聆聽係聽錄音然後答題嘅部分，測驗成日排第一。
example_en: Listening comes first in the test.
example_zh: 測驗先做聆聽。
tip: 聆聽卷叫 the listening paper；動詞係 listen。
icon_idea: a kitten listening with soft headphones

explain_yue: 溫習係放學之後再睇一次今日學過嘅嘢。
example_en: I study English after a nap.
example_zh: 瞓完午覺我溫英文。
tip: study 係動詞原形；而家進行式先係 studying。我溫書可以講 I study。
icon_idea: a kitten studying with a blanket nearby

explain_yue: 教係將你識嘅嘢講俾人知，老師教你，你都可以教同學一個字。
example_zh: 請教我呢個字。
tip: teach 後面可以加人同嘢：teach me this word。過去式係 taught。
icon_idea: a kitten teaching another kitten one word

explain_yue: 答係回應問題，可以用一個字或者一句完整句子。
example_en: Please answer in a full sentence.
example_zh: 請用完整句子答。
tip: 動詞 answer 唔使加 to：answer the question。名詞先係 an answer。
icon_idea: a kitten writing an answer on a card

explain_yue: 發問係向人提出問題，唔明白可以有禮貌咁問。
example_en: You can question the teacher politely.
example_zh: 你可以有禮貌咁問老師。
tip: 本季 question 做動詞係發問；名詞「一條問題」先係 a question。
icon_idea: a kitten raising a paw to question

explain_yue: 解釋係將難明嘅地方講清楚，可以用例子幫手。
example_zh: 請解釋呢一頁。
tip: explain 後面直接加嘢：explain this page。唔好講 explain me。
icon_idea: a kitten explaining with a speech bubble

explain_yue: 明白係你跟到個意思，跟到就可以自己做。
example_zh: 我而家明白個故事。
tip: 唔明白就講 I do not understand. 可以再問一次，好平常。
icon_idea: a kitten with a small light bulb of understanding

explain_yue: 記得係將生字或者步驟留喺腦入面，下次仲搵到。
example_zh: 我記得啲生字。
tip: 記得做某樣嘢可以講 remember to bring a pen。
icon_idea: a kitten with a little memory cloud of words

explain_yue: revise 係英式講溫書，考試前將筆記再睇一次。
example_en: I revise five words before bed.
example_zh: 瞓前我溫五個字。
tip: 英式 revise ＝溫書；美式成日用 review。改文章嗰個 revise 係另一個意思。
icon_idea: a kitten revising words before bedtime

explain_yue: 抄係照住黑板或者書將字寫落簿。
example_en: I copy the date into my notebook.
example_zh: 我將日期抄入筆記簿。
tip: 抄落簿可以講 copy the sentence。copy 做名詞先係「一份副本」。
icon_idea: a kitten copying the date into a notebook

explain_yue: 串字係將一個字嘅字母順序講出嚟或者寫出嚟。
example_zh: 你可唔可以串你個名？
tip: 問點串可以講 How do you spell it? 拼寫本身叫 spelling。
icon_idea: a kitten spelling with alphabet blocks

explain_yue: 計數係用加減乘除去計個答案。
example_zh: 我哋一齊計總數。
tip: 計總數講 calculate the total；用計數機就 use a calculator。
icon_idea: a kitten calculating with fish-shaped counters

explain_yue: 劃底線係喺重要嘅字下面畫一條線，方便之後搵。
example_zh: 喺生字下面劃線。
tip: 工作紙成日寫 Underline the verb. 即係喺動詞下面劃線。
icon_idea: a kitten underlining a word in a notebook

explain_yue: 打剔係喺正確答案旁邊畫一個剔號。
example_zh: 喺正確嘅格打剔。
tip: 英式打剔叫 tick；美式成日叫 check。剔號本身係 a tick。
icon_idea: a kitten making a tick on a box

explain_yue: 打交叉係喺唔要嘅答案上面畫叉，表示劃走。
example_zh: 將錯嘅字打交叉。
tip: 課堂上 cross 係打交叉；cross 亦可以係「橫過」，例如 cross the road。
icon_idea: a kitten marking a gentle cross on a word

explain_yue: 合格係測驗或者考試達到要求，做到就可以收工休息。
example_en: I hope to pass the quiz.
example_zh: 我希望小測合格。
tip: 本季 pass 係合格；pass 亦可以係「傳過去」或者「經過」。
icon_idea: a kitten with a small star after a quiz

explain_yue: 今次未過關，休息一陣再試一次就得。
example_en: It is okay to fail once and try again.
example_zh: 今次未過都冇事，可以再試。
tip: fail 係今次未過；再練幾個字就可以，唔使責自己。
icon_idea: a calm kitten beside a second-chance seedling

explain_yue: 重溫係將讀過嘅一章再睇一次，等自己記得穩陣啲。
example_zh: 我哋一齊重溫呢一章。
tip: review 係重溫；英式「考前溫書」更常用 revise。
icon_idea: two kittens reviewing a chapter together

explain_yue: 準備係事前將書包、筆同書放好，第二日就輕鬆啲。
example_en: I prepare my bag the night before.
example_zh: 我前一晚準備好書包。
tip: prepare for a test 即係為測驗做準備，前一晚執好書包都算。
icon_idea: a kitten preparing a bag the night before school

explain_yue: 集中精神係一段短時間專心跳一件事，做完可以休息。
example_en: I focus for ten minutes, then rest.
example_zh: 我集中十分鐘，然後休息。
tip: focus on 後面加件事：focus on this page。十分鐘已經好夠。
icon_idea: a kitten focusing for a short timer, then napping

explain_yue: 重複係將同一個字或者句子再講一次，幫你記得。
example_zh: 請慢慢重複呢個字。
tip: 跟住讀可以講 Please repeat after me.
icon_idea: a kitten repeating a word with two speech bubbles

explain_yue: 背誦係唔睇書將詩或者課文講出嚟。
example_en: We recite a short poem in class.
example_zh: 我哋喺堂上背一首短詩。
tip: 背詩講 recite a poem；默書係寫，recite 係講出嚟。
icon_idea: a kitten reciting a tiny poem

explain_yue: 背熟係將字或者句子記到可以自己寫出嚟，英式拼寫用 s。
example_en: I memorise five words a day.
example_zh: 我一日背熟五個字。
tip: 英式寫 memorise；美式寫 memorize。一日五個字已經好夠。
icon_idea: a kitten memorising five word cards

explain_yue: 解開係將一條數學題或者謎題做到有答案。
example_zh: 我哋一齊解開一條謎題。
tip: 解數學題講 solve the problem；一個謎題就 solve a puzzle。
icon_idea: a kitten solving a small puzzle

explain_yue: 翻譯係將一句說話由一種語言變成另一種。
example_zh: 請翻譯呢句。
tip: 譯成中文講 translate into Chinese；名詞係 translation。
icon_idea: a kitten translating a sentence between two bubbles

explain_yue: 摘要係用很少句子講返成個故事嘅重點，英式拼寫用 s。
example_en: Summarise the story in one line.
example_zh: 用一行摘要個故事。
tip: 英式寫 summarise；美式寫 summarize。一句講完重點就得。
icon_idea: a kitten summarising a story into one line

explain_yue: 功課係放學帶返屋企做嘅練習。
example_en: I do my homework after dinner.
example_zh: 我食完晚飯做功課。
tip: homework 當不可數，唔好講 homeworks。做功課用 do homework。
icon_idea: a kitten doing homework after a rice bowl

explain_yue: 作業係老師指定要交嘅一份工作，有時比日常功課長。
example_en: This assignment is due on Friday.
example_zh: 呢份作業星期五交。
tip: 交作業限期講 due on Friday；一份叫 an assignment。
icon_idea: a kitten with an assignment and a Friday sticker

explain_yue: 測驗係課堂上嘅小考，範圍通常係最近教過嘅嘢。
example_zh: 我聽日有測驗。
tip: 聽日有測驗講 I have a test tomorrow. 溫幾個字就得。
icon_idea: a kitten with a small test paper and a snack

explain_yue: 考試係比較正式、範圍比較大嘅考核，多數喺學期末。
example_zh: 考試喺下星期。
tip: exam 係 examination 嘅簡稱；測驗細啲叫 test 或者 quiz。
icon_idea: a kitten calendar with a calm mark for next week's exam

explain_yue: 小測係短短嘅測驗，有時得幾條題目。
example_en: We have a short quiz today.
example_zh: 今日有個小測。
tip: quiz 複數係 quizzes。短小測可以講 a short quiz。
icon_idea: a kitten taking a short quiz

explain_yue: 成績係測驗或者考試出嚟嘅結果，出咗就知道自己識幾多。
example_en: The result comes out on Friday.
example_zh: 成績星期五出。
tip: 一個結果叫 a result；幾科一齊先叫 results。出成績講 come out。
icon_idea: a kitten opening a result envelope calmly

explain_yue: 成績表係學校派俾家長睇嘅報告，上面有各科表現。
example_en: My school report is in the bag.
example_zh: 我張成績表喺袋入面。
tip: school report 就係成績表；派成績表嘅日子叫 report day。
icon_idea: a kitten with a school report tucked in a bag

explain_yue: 證書係證明你完成一件事或者有份成績嘅紙。
example_en: She got a certificate for reading.
example_zh: 佢閱讀攞到一張證書。
tip: 一張證書叫 a certificate；閱讀獎、出席獎都會派。
icon_idea: a kitten holding a reading certificate

explain_yue: 獎品係比賽或者好表現得到嘅禮物。
example_en: The prize is a new book.
example_zh: 獎品係一本新書。
tip: 贏到獎品講 win a prize；第一名嘅獎可以叫 the first prize。
icon_idea: a kitten with a prize book and a ribbon

explain_yue: 獎牌係掛喺頸或者別喺衫上面嘅獎，例如金牌。
example_zh: 佢贏到一面金牌。
tip: 金牌 a gold medal，銀牌 a silver medal，銅牌 a bronze medal。
icon_idea: a kitten wearing a gold medal and napping

explain_yue: 比賽係同其他人比試嘅活動，例如演講比賽。
example_en: The speech competition is on Friday.
example_zh: 演講比賽星期五舉行。
tip: 參加比賽講 enter a competition 或者 join a competition。
icon_idea: a kitten at a speech competition microphone

explain_yue: contest 都係比賽，規模可以細啲，例如班內繪畫比賽。
example_zh: 我參加繪畫比賽。
tip: 名詞讀 /ˈkɒntest/；同 competition 都係比賽，班內小比賽成日叫 contest。
icon_idea: a kitten joining a drawing contest

explain_yue: 演講係一個人企出嚟講一段有準備嘅話。
example_en: Her speech is two minutes long.
example_zh: 佢個演講有兩分鐘。
tip: 做演講講 give a speech；兩分鐘就 two minutes long。
icon_idea: a kitten giving a two-minute speech

explain_yue: 簡報係向班上展示你嘅專題，可以有海報或者投影。
example_zh: 我哋簡報係關於貓。
tip: 做簡報講 give a presentation；題目用 about 帶出嚟。
icon_idea: a kitten presenting a poster about cats

explain_yue: 文章係圍繞一個題目寫嘅較長文字，有開頭同結尾。
example_en: I write an essay about my school.
example_zh: 我寫一篇關於學校嘅文章。
tip: 一篇文章 an essay；香港小學作文有時叫 composition，中學多叫 essay。
icon_idea: a kitten writing an essay about school

explain_yue: 段落係文章入面一組連住嘅句子，通常講一個細點。
example_en: This paragraph is short and clear.
example_zh: 呢段又短又清楚。
tip: 新一段要另起一行；一段叫 a paragraph。
icon_idea: a kitten looking at one short paragraph

explain_yue: 句子係有開頭有結尾、表達一個完整意思嘅一行字。
example_en: Write one sentence about your cat.
example_zh: 用一句寫你隻貓。
tip: 一句完整句子通常有大階開頭同句號；a full sentence 就係完整句子。
icon_idea: a kitten writing one sentence about a cat

explain_yue: 錯處係寫錯或者計錯嘅地方，搵到就可以改。
example_en: I found a mistake and fixed it.
example_zh: 我搵到個錯處，改好咗。
tip: 犯錯講 make a mistake；搵到就改，改完多識一樣。
icon_idea: a kitten fixing a small mistake with a rubber

explain_yue: error 都係錯誤，科學同電腦題目成日用呢個字。
example_en: There is a small error on page two.
example_zh: 第二頁有個小錯誤。
tip: error 同 mistake 都係錯；電腦顯示訊息成日講 error。
icon_idea: a kitten spotting a tiny error with a magnifier

explain_yue: 正確係答案啱，可以打一個剔。
example_zh: 你個答案係正確。
tip: 本季 correct 係形容詞「正確」；做動詞先係「改正」，例如 correct the mistake。
icon_idea: a kitten sticker with a tick that says correct

explain_yue: 錯係答案唔啱，劃走再試下一個就得。
example_en: This answer is wrong, so try another.
example_zh: 呢個答案唔啱，試下另一個。
tip: wrong 係形容詞；正確係 correct。試下一個選擇就得。
icon_idea: a kitten trying another answer after a gentle mark

explain_yue: 口試係用講嘅方式考核，老師聽你講。
example_en: The oral test is on Thursday.
example_zh: 口試喺星期四。
tip: 口試叫 an oral test 或者 oral exam；同筆試 written 相對。
icon_idea: a relaxed kitten at an oral test microphone

explain_yue: 筆試係用寫嘅方式考核，喺紙上作答。
example_en: The written test is in the hall.
example_zh: 筆試喺禮堂。
tip: written 係 write 嘅過去分詞，呢度當形容詞：written test 即係筆試。
icon_idea: a kitten at a written test in a sunny hall

explain_yue: 分數係老師俾你嘅得分，例如英文八十分。
example_en: Her mark for English is eighty.
example_zh: 佢英文分數係八十分。
tip: 本季＝分數；另外有「標記」。滿分可以講 full marks。
icon_idea: a kitten report showing an English mark

explain_yue: points 係題目上面嘅分數單位，一題可以值幾個 points。
example_en: This quiz is worth ten points.
example_zh: 呢個小測總共十分。
tip: 一個分數先叫 a point；兩個或以上先用 points。呢張卡係複數 points。
icon_idea: a kitten collecting ten star points

explain_yue: 課室入面要跟嘅規矩就係 rule。
example_zh: 呢條規矩係公道嘅。
tip: 課室規矩講 a class rule；多過一條就係 rules。
icon_idea: a lazy cat pointing at a short classroom rule chart

explain_yue: 課室要靜、唔好周圍講嘢，就係 quiet。
example_zh: 請安靜啲，唔好嘈。
tip: Be quiet＝請安靜；keep quiet＝保持安靜。
icon_idea: a lazy cat with a paw on its lips in a quiet classroom

explain_yue: 想答題先舉手，呢個動作就係 raise。
example_zh: 請舉手，唔好搶住講。
tip: raise your hand＝舉手；過去式 raised。
icon_idea: a lazy cat raising one paw before speaking

explain_yue: 老師叫你企起身，呢個動作就係 stand。
example_zh: 請企起身，唔好坐住。
tip: stand up＝企起身；sit down＝坐下。
icon_idea: a lazy cat standing up beside a school desk

explain_yue: 叫你坐下，呢個動作就係 sit。
example_zh: 請坐下，唔好企住。
tip: sit down＝坐下；sit 過去式 sat。
icon_idea: a lazy cat sitting neatly on a classroom chair

explain_yue: 一齊排好隊，呢個動作就係 line up。
example_zh: 請排隊，唔好插隊。
tip: line up＝排隊；a line 係一條隊伍。
icon_idea: lazy cats lining up calmly by a classroom door

explain_yue: 做嘢留神、唔好急，就係 careful。
example_zh: 請小心啲，唔好急。
tip: Be careful＝小心啲；名詞係 care。
icon_idea: a lazy cat stepping carefully around a wet floor sign

explain_yue: 枱面整齊、唔亂，就係 tidy。
example_zh: 書枱要保持整齊，唔好亂。
tip: keep tidy＝保持整齊；tidy 亦可做動詞，to tidy the desk。
icon_idea: a lazy cat patting books into a tidy pile

explain_yue: 今日冇返學、唔喺課室，就係 absent。
example_zh: Ken 今日缺席，唔喺課室。
tip: be absent＝缺席；人返到就係 present。
icon_idea: a lazy cat desk with an empty chair and a small absent note

explain_yue: 人喺課室、有出席，就係 present。
example_zh: 個個學生都出席，冇人唔喺度。
tip: 本季＝出席；禮物用 gift，唔好搞亂
icon_idea: a lazy cat ticking a present mark on the class register

explain_yue: 未問准就唔好做，要先攞 permission。
example_zh: 先問准先得，唔好自己做。
tip: ask for permission＝先問准唔准。
icon_idea: a lazy cat holding up a small permission slip

explain_yue: 留心聽老師講，就係 pay attention。
example_zh: 請留心，唔好望出窗。
tip: pay attention＝留心聽；attention 係名詞。
icon_idea: a lazy cat with wide eyes looking at the teacher

explain_yue: 喺課室守規矩、唔搗亂，就係 behave。
example_zh: 喺課室要守規矩，唔好搗亂。
tip: behave well＝守規矩；名詞係 behaviour（英式）。
icon_idea: a lazy cat sitting politely with paws together

explain_yue: 講嘢有禮、唔粗魯，就係 polite。
example_zh: 對同學要有禮，唔好惡聲惡氣。
tip: Be polite＝有禮啲；反義係 rude。
icon_idea: a lazy cat bowing politely with a small smile

explain_yue: 尊重人同規矩，呢種態度就係 respect。
example_zh: 喺課室要尊重人，唔好取笑同學。
tip: show respect＝表示尊重；respect 亦可做動詞。
icon_idea: two lazy cats nodding to each other with respect

explain_yue: 跟住規矩去做，就係 follow。
example_zh: 請跟住呢條規矩，唔好當冇到。
tip: follow the rule＝跟規矩；follow 亦有跟住人行。
icon_idea: a lazy cat following paw prints along a rule path

explain_yue: 服從指示、唔抗拒，就係 obey。
example_zh: 我哋服從課室規矩，唔係扮聽唔到。
tip: obey 語氣硬過 follow，係服從指示。
icon_idea: a lazy cat reading a rule scroll and nodding

explain_yue: 老師准你做，就係 allow。
example_zh: 老師准人問公道嘅問題。
tip: allow 係准，forbid 係禁。
icon_idea: a lazy cat teacher giving a small nod of permission

explain_yue: 規矩寫明唔准，就係 forbid。
example_zh: 規矩可能禁止用電話，唔准喺堂上玩。
tip: forbid 係禁止；過去式 forbade。
icon_idea: a lazy cat beside a gentle no-phone classroom sign

explain_yue: 犯咗清楚嘅規矩先至受到處罰，就係 punish。
example_en: The school does not punish a small mistake.
example_zh: 學校唔會為咗一個小錯就處罰人。
tip: 處罰先用 punish；小事先用 remind 就得。
icon_idea: a lazy cat looking at a tiny scale, calm and fair

explain_yue: 做得好得到嘅獎勵，就係 reward。
example_en: A sticker is a nice reward.
example_zh: 一張貼紙係一份幾好嘅獎勵。
tip: a reward＝一份獎勵；reward 亦可做動詞。
icon_idea: a lazy cat holding a gold star sticker reward

explain_yue: 用說話讚人，就係 praise。
example_zh: 老師會讚有禮嘅學生。
tip: praise 多係口頭讚；reward 多係一份獎。
icon_idea: a lazy cat clapping for a classmate

explain_yue: 事先話你知有風險，就係 warn。
example_en: Please warn me if the bell rings.
example_zh: 如果鐘響就提醒我，唔好唔出聲。
tip: warn somebody＝事先話人知要小心。
icon_idea: a lazy cat pointing at a small classroom warning bell

explain_yue: 怕人唔記得，再提一次，就係 remind。
example_en: Please remind me about the test.
example_zh: 請提醒我有測驗，唔好等我唔記得。
tip: remind somebody to…＝提醒人做某事。
icon_idea: a lazy cat with a little bell reminder note

explain_yue: 全班有秩序、唔混亂，就係 discipline。
example_en: Good discipline keeps the class calm.
example_zh: 好嘅紀律令課堂保持平靜，唔會亂。
tip: keep discipline＝維持秩序；呢個詞係名詞。
icon_idea: a lazy cat keeping a calm orderly row of books

explain_yue: 你做嘅一份工，就係 job。
example_zh: 呢份工啱我，唔係太趕。
tip: a job＝一份工；問職業可以講 What do you do?
icon_idea: a lazy cat hugging a small work bag

explain_yue: 你日常做開嘅工作，就係 work。
example_zh: 我鍾意呢份工作，唔覺悶。
tip: 去上班講 go to work；work 亦可做動詞。
icon_idea: a lazy cat at a small desk with a neat work folder

explain_yue: 做嘢嘅人就係 worker。
example_zh: 每個工作者都有證，唔係冇名冇姓。
tip: -er 表示做呢樣嘢嘅人，worker＝工作者。
icon_idea: a lazy cat worker wearing a small badge

explain_yue: 請你、管你嘅人就係 boss。
example_zh: 我老闆會聽我哋講，唔係淨係發號施令。
tip: my boss＝我嘅老闆。
icon_idea: a lazy cat boss in a loose tie, listening kindly

explain_yue: 管一個部門嘅人就係 manager。
example_zh: 經理會睇份計劃，唔會唔理。
tip: manager＝經理，管一個部門嘅人。
icon_idea: a lazy cat manager with a clipboard

explain_yue: 同你一齊做嘢嘅人就係 colleague。
example_zh: 我同事同我共用張書枱，唔係各有一間房。
tip: colleague＝同事；英式讀 /ˈkɒliːɡ/。
icon_idea: two lazy cat colleagues sharing one sunny desk

explain_yue: 一間公司成班員工就係 staff。
example_zh: 員工一齊食午餐，唔係個個自己食。
tip: staff 係員工總稱，當一組人，動詞常用複數。
icon_idea: a small group of lazy cat staff eating lunch

explain_yue: 有職位嘅人員，例如警務人員，可以叫 officer。
example_en: An officer helps at the gate.
example_zh: 有位人員喺門口幫手，唔會唔理人。
tip: police officer＝警察；officer 亦可用喺其他職位。
icon_idea: a lazy cat officer with a soft cap at a school gate

explain_yue: 揸車嘅人就係 driver。
example_en: The driver waits at the gate.
example_zh: 司機喺門口等，唔會亂開車。
tip: bus driver＝巴士司機。
icon_idea: a lazy cat driver waving from a small car

explain_yue: 餐廳入面煮食嘅師傅就係 chef。
example_zh: 廚師今日煮湯，唔係淨係切菜。
tip: chef 係廚師，尤其係餐廳主廚；讀 /ʃef/。
icon_idea: a lazy cat chef in a tall hat stirring soup

explain_yue: 維持治安嘅警察隊就係 the police。
example_zh: 警察會幫迷路嘅小朋友，唔會當睇唔到。
tip: the police 當一隊人，動詞多用複數：The police are here。
icon_idea: a lazy cat police officer beside a tiny police car

explain_yue: 負責救火嘅人就係 firefighter。
example_zh: 消防員戴頭盔，唔係普通帽。
tip: firefighter＝消防員；呢度嘅 fire 係火，人先係 firefighter。
icon_idea: a lazy cat firefighter in a helmet with a small hose

explain_yue: 派信上門嘅人就係 postman。
example_zh: 郵差中午之前到，唔會等到夜晚。
tip: postman＝郵差；而家亦有人講 mail carrier。
icon_idea: a lazy cat postman with a letter bag

explain_yue: 種田養動物嘅人就係 farmer。
example_zh: 農夫餵雞，唔會唔理佢哋。
tip: farmer＝農夫；farm 係農場。
icon_idea: a lazy cat farmer with a straw hat and hens

explain_yue: 開飛機嘅人就係 pilot。
example_zh: 機師同乘客打招呼，唔會唔出聲。
tip: pilot＝飛機師。
icon_idea: a lazy cat pilot in a cap waving from a plane window

explain_yue: 靠唱歌表演嘅人就係 singer。
example_en: The singer bows after the song.
example_zh: 歌手唱完會鞠躬，唔會即刻走。
tip: singer＝歌手；sing 係唱。
icon_idea: a lazy cat singer with a microphone

explain_yue: 演戲嘅男演員就係 actor。
example_zh: 男演員要背劇本，唔係上台先睇。
tip: actor 傳統指男演員；而家男女都可用 actor。
icon_idea: a lazy cat actor holding a comedy mask

explain_yue: 演戲嘅女演員就係 actress。
example_zh: 女演員要背劇本，唔係臨場先睇。
tip: actress＝女演員。
icon_idea: a lazy cat actress with a clapperboard

explain_yue: 用工程知識解決問題嘅人就係 engineer。
example_zh: 工程師檢查條橋，唔會估估下。
tip: engineer＝工程師；重音喺後面 -neer。
icon_idea: a lazy cat engineer with a tiny wrench and a bridge plan

explain_yue: 負責設計樣貌同圖則嘅人就係 designer。
example_zh: 設計師畫海報，唔係亂塗。
tip: designer＝設計師；design 係設計。
icon_idea: a lazy cat designer sketching a poster

explain_yue: 寫程式嘅人就係 programmer。
example_zh: 程式員寫遊戲，唔係淨係打字。
tip: programmer＝寫程式嘅人。
icon_idea: a lazy cat programmer napping beside a laptop

explain_yue: 整麵包同蛋糕嘅人就係 baker。
example_zh: 麵包師賣新鮮麵包，唔係賣隔夜貨。
tip: baker＝麵包師；bake 係烘。
icon_idea: a lazy cat baker with a warm loaf of bread

explain_yue: 幫人剪頭髮嘅人就係 barber。
example_zh: 理髮師剪得整齊，唔會剪到歪。
tip: barber＝理髮師；barber shop＝理髮店。
icon_idea: a lazy cat barber with scissors and a striped pole

explain_yue: 處理法律問題嘅人就係 lawyer。
example_zh: 律師解釋條規矩，唔會講到含糊。
tip: lawyer＝律師；讀 /ˈlɔːjə/。
icon_idea: a lazy cat lawyer with a small law book

explain_yue: 幫人檢查同治理牙齒嘅人就係 dentist。
example_zh: 牙醫檢查我啲牙，唔係淨係睇一睇。
tip: 睇牙講 see a dentist。
icon_idea: a lazy cat dentist with a tiny mirror and a smile

explain_yue: 大家坐低一齊開會，就係 meeting。
example_en: We have a meeting at ten.
example_zh: 我哋十點開會，唔好遲到。
tip: have a meeting＝開會。
icon_idea: lazy cats around a small meeting table

explain_yue: 求職嗰陣同僱主見面傾，就係 interview。
example_en: I have an interview at two.
example_zh: 我兩點有面試，唔可以遲到。
tip: a job interview＝求職面試。
icon_idea: a lazy cat in a neat collar at an interview desk

explain_yue: 每月或者每年計嘅薪金就係 salary。
example_zh: 佢嘅薪金每月出，唔係日日結。
tip: salary 多數指月薪或者年薪；wage 多數指時薪或週薪。
icon_idea: a lazy cat looking at a monthly pay envelope

explain_yue: 按鐘、按日或者按星期計嘅人工就係 wage。
example_en: His wage is paid each week.
example_zh: 佢嘅工資每星期出，唔係一年先出一次。
tip: wage 多數係時薪、日薪或者週薪。
icon_idea: a lazy cat holding a small weekly wage note

explain_yue: 你想要呢份工，唔好空等，就要 apply。
example_zh: 我申請呢份工，唔係隨便問吓。
tip: 本季＝申請工；另外有「應用」
icon_idea: a lazy cat filling in a job form

explain_yue: 你交出去嘅申請表或者申請信就係 application。
example_zh: 我今日交申請，唔會拖。
tip: application 係 apply 嘅名詞，一份申請。
icon_idea: a lazy cat sliding an application form across a desk

explain_yue: 英國人講嘅履歷就係 cv。
example_en: Bring your cv to the interview.
example_zh: 面試記得帶履歷，唔好空手去。
tip: cv 係英式履歷，兩個字母分開讀 /ˌsiː ˈviː/。
icon_idea: a lazy cat holding a short cv page

explain_yue: 美國人講嘅履歷就係 resume，同 cv 係同一樣嘢。
example_zh: 請電郵你份履歷，唔好只係口講。
tip: 求職履歷讀 /ˈrezjumeɪ/；唔好讀成「繼續」嗰個 resume。
icon_idea: a lazy cat emailing a resume from a laptop

explain_yue: 電腦用來打字嘅鍵盤就係 keyboard。
example_zh: 呢個鍵盤好靜，唔會嘈。
tip: keyboard＝鍵盤，key 加 board。
icon_idea: a lazy cat resting its paws on a quiet keyboard

explain_yue: 部用來印文件嘅機就係 printer。
example_en: The printer sits by the window.
example_zh: 部打印機放喺窗邊，唔係放喺地下。
tip: printer＝打印機；動詞係 print。
icon_idea: a lazy cat watching a small printer by a window

explain_yue: 將文件印出嚟，呢個動作就係 print。
example_zh: 請印呢一頁，唔好只係睇螢幕。
tip: print＝打印；部機叫 printer。
icon_idea: a lazy cat pressing print as a page comes out

explain_yue: 一份正式文件就係 document。
example_zh: 請睇呢份文件，唔好簽錯。
tip: a document＝一份文件；名詞重音喺第一音節。
icon_idea: a lazy cat reading a document with a paw on the page

explain_yue: 你親手簽落去嘅名就係 signature。
example_zh: 我需要你喺呢度簽名，唔可以代簽。
tip: signature＝簽名；動詞係 sign。
icon_idea: a lazy cat signing a page with a paw-print signature

explain_yue: 交文件嘅最後期限就係 deadline。
example_zh: 星期五係截止日期，唔好過咗先交。
tip: deadline＝截止日期；meet a deadline＝趕得切。
